instruction: Where is the Final Year Project review committee based?
response: The Final Year Project review committee is based in the Ramanujan Annexe, third floor, room RA-314.

instruction: When are the Final Year Project supervisor office hours?
response: Final Year Project supervisor office hours run every Tuesday from 3:00 pm to 5:00 pm in the Ramanujan Annexe, room RA-314.

instruction: How many credits is the final year project worth?
response: It carries 3 credits in the seventh semester and 12 credits in the eighth semester.

instruction: Which building houses the Computer Science department?
response: The Computer Science department is housed in the Bhaskara Block, which sits directly north of the central library.

instruction: What are the central library opening hours?
response: The central library is open from 8:00 am to 10:00 pm on weekdays, and from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm on Saturdays. It is closed on Sundays and public holidays.

instruction: How many books can an undergraduate borrow at once?
response: An undergraduate student may borrow up to four books at a time, for a loan period of fourteen days.

instruction: What is the minimum attendance requirement?
response: Students must maintain at least 75 percent attendance in every registered course to be eligible to sit the end-semester examination.

instruction: How do I apply for a bonafide certificate?
response: Submit a written request to the Office of the Registrar along with your student identity card. The certificate is normally issued within three working days.

instruction: What is the grading scale used for undergraduate courses?
response: Undergraduate courses use a ten-point scale, where A equals 10 points, B equals 8, C equals 6, D equals 4 and F is a fail carrying no points.

instruction: Where do I collect my examination hall ticket?
response: Hall tickets are collected from the Examination Cell on the ground floor of the Ramanujan Annexe, starting one week before the examination period.

instruction: Who supervises final year projects in the Computer Science department?
response: Final year projects are supervised by faculty members of the department, and each project is assigned a single supervisor by the departmental project committee.

instruction: What is the maximum team size for a final year project?
response: A final year project team may have at most four students, and every team must have a single nominated point of contact.

instruction: Is there a dress code for laboratory sessions?
response: Closed shoes and a full-length lab coat are required in all wet laboratories. Computing laboratories have no dress code beyond closed shoes.

instruction: How do I reserve a group study room?
response: Group study rooms in the central library are reserved at the circulation desk, up to two days in advance, for a maximum of three hours per booking.

instruction: What happens if I miss an end-semester examination?
response: A student who misses an end-semester examination for a documented medical reason may apply to the Examination Cell for a make-up examination within seven days.

instruction: Where is the student health centre?
response: The student health centre is on the ground floor of the Bhaskara Block, and is open from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm on weekdays.

instruction: How many elective courses must an undergraduate complete?
response: An undergraduate must complete six elective courses in total, of which at least two must be taken outside the home department.

instruction: Can I change my project supervisor?
response: A change of supervisor requires written consent from both the current and the proposed supervisor, and approval from the departmental project committee.

instruction: What is the policy on plagiarism in project reports?
response: Project reports are checked for similarity, and a similarity index above fifteen percent is referred to the academic integrity committee for review.

instruction: Where can I find the campus shuttle timetable?
response: The campus shuttle timetable is posted at the main gate kiosk and outside the Bhaskara Block entrance. Shuttles run every twenty minutes between 7:00 am and 9:00 pm.
